preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The size of the array N must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= A[i] < N for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array A must be between -1 and N-1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(1 <= P[i] <= N for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, output -1; otherwise, output a valid permutation P.

postconditions.expression: all(P[i] != P[j] for i in range(N) for j in range(i+1, N))
postconditions.description: The permutation P must contain each element from 1 to N exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(A[i] == 0 or A[i] == max(j for j in range(i) if P[j] > P[i]) for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: The array A must be generated from the permutation P according to the specified rules.
